content:
Sarah M: hey team — first full draft of the launch post is up: https://docs.redwood.com/launch/draft-optimise-v1 please skim for voice/timing. want to lock hero and webinar CTA by EOD so we can wire up the lead routing.
Josh K: reading now. main q: do we lead with benchmarks or customer quote? leaning quote for top fold.
Sarah M: good call — i think quote hooks better for PLG audience. can we shorten the benchmark section and put a deep-dive appendix?
Elaine R: quick legal note — re: customer quote we need approvals from their comms team. @Sarah M can you confirm we have opt-in?
Sarah M: liaising with @Ben D and customer success today, should have sign-off by 3pm.
Priya S: routing note — if hero CTA is "Register for live demo", we need 2 HubSpot entry points: webinar form and general demo form. can map to different nurture paths.
Priya S: proposed mapping: \n```\nwebinar_form -> list: Launch_Webinar_24 -> workflow: webinar_nurture_v1\ndemo_form -> list: Trial_Interest_24 -> workflow: product_intro_seq\n```\nWould that work for ops?
ContentOps Bot: checklist: draft uploaded, assets linked, hero image missing, hero CTA set to "Register for live demo" pending.
Ben D: putting a hero mock in the doc rn. suggestion: use a cropped gif of the UI to keep motion in feed.
Josh K: copy tweak suggestion for headline: change "Scale LLM inference" to "Ship LLM features faster" — more product-y. thoughts?
Sarah M: love that. headline updated in doc.
Priya S: downstream: after registration, we should tag by use-case (embeddings vs generation) using a hidden field on the form so SDRs can route. I'll add the hidden field names to the doc.
Elaine R: once quote sign-off is in, i can fast-track the legal ok for release wording.
Ben D: hero image uploaded, filename: hero-dash-2026.gif. added alt text.
Josh K: final ask — can we get a short 30s script for the webinar landing panel? I can draft but need key bullets: perf, cost, reliability.
Sarah M: @Josh K please draft a 2-sentence panel blurb, I'll shorten for mobile.
Priya S: leaving this here — tests to run: UTM param mapping, form hidden fields validation, double opt-in checkbox.
ContentOps Bot: scheduled preflight reminder set for 1770001600 (30m before publish window).
Sarah M: ok team — plan: finish copy + hero by 3pm, legal/pass by 4:30, routing validated by Priya by 5pm. if all green, we target publish tomorrow 09:00 PT. :rocket:
